name: Private Internet Access
author: Vitor Pacheco
description: Private Internet Access VPN in the Omarchy bar: connect, disconnect, pick a region, switch protocol, port forwarding and quick IP copy, all through piactl.

barWidget.description: Toggle the PIA VPN, choose a region, switch protocol and copy your VPN or public IP.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: Fallback polling. State changes are also pushed live by piactl monitor, so this only matters when the monitor is unavailable.

schema.label: Path to piactl
schema.description: Leave empty to find piactl on PATH or in /opt/piavpn/bin.

schema.label: Enable background mode before connecting
schema.description: Runs `piactl background enable` so the VPN stays up without the PIA desktop client open.

schema.label: Notify on connection changes
schema.description: Send a desktop notification when the VPN connects, disconnects or is interrupted.

schema.label: Recent regions to keep
schema.description: How many recently used regions to pin under the Regions section.
